create_class_llm: create an LLM class instance to generate text responses from a prompt using Gemini 1.5 Pro
generate_llm_response: generate a text response from the LLM class given a prompt string
generate_json_llm_response: generate a JSON-constrained text response from the LLM class using response_mime_type application/json
create_image_generator: create an ImageGenerator class instance to generate images from text prompts using Imagen 3.0
generate_single_image: generate a single image from a text conversation prompt with a given seed using the ImageGenerator class
generate_diverse_images: generate four diverse images from a text conversation prompt with a given seed using the ImageGenerator class
